jelly-land.text: One large soft gel blob dropping once onto a stone floor. A clear loud low-pitched slap with a firm rounded attack and a dense muffled thud. Short, weighty and easy to hear in a game. One isolated impact only. No second hit, bounce, sharp click, splash, voice, music or reverb.

spikes.text: A single steel sword blade being drawn smoothly from a tight leather and metal scabbard. One compact rising metallic shing: controlled blade friction, a clean bright steel resonance and a subtle release at the end. spikes-retract.text: A single steel sword blade being slid smoothly back into a tight leather and metal scabbard. One compact descending metallic shing: controlled blade friction, a muted steel resonance, ending with a soft firm seat in the sheath. Dense and tactile, quick but not aggressive, close dry isolated game sound. No sword strike, impact, combat swing, chains, coins, machinery, voice, music or reverb.

portal.text: One cold magical portal transporting a small creature. A deep frosty vibration swells inward, layered with a smooth icy resonance, fine crystalline trembling and a brief subzero shimmer. Hollow, spectral and tactile, with a soft onset and a short vibrating tail. Chilled blue energy, close isolated game sound. No liquid glug, no warm bass, no sharp glass break, no bell melody, no electric zap, no explosive whoosh, no voice or music.

dungeon-wind.text: Seamless ambience of low air moving through an ancient underground stone corridor. Hollow drafts, subtle pressure fluctuations and distant airy resonance. Quiet, spacious and uneasy, with no distinct repeating events. No voices, no choir, no music, no sudden sounds.

torch-light.text: A wooden match being struck and catching on a wall torch. One quick dry scratch of a match head on rough stone, a crisp little sulfur flare, then a soft rounded whoosh as a small oily flame catches and settles into a gentle crackle. Close, warm and intimate game sound, short and clear. No explosion, no big fire roar, no metal, no voice, no music, no reverb.

torch-out.text: A small torch flame being snuffed out. One short soft wet fizz like a fingertip pinching a candle wick, a quick fading hiss of steam and a faint airy puff of smoke. ui-move.text: One minimal neutral UI navigation tick. lift-down.text: A heavy stone lift descending slowly along a smooth stone shaft. torch-swoosh.text: One classic small fantasy torch ignition: a quick soft sweep of fire through air, then a warm rounded flame whoosh that catches and settles immediately. Smooth and restrained, close game sound. No match strike, explosion, roar, sharp crackle, voice, music or reverb.
